subject: Re: LumenWare technical walkthrough — need to shift timing because of procurement blackout
messages:
From: Ethan Cooper <ethan.cooper@lumenware.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@lumenware.com, Sandra Li <sandra.li@lumenware.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Need to move technical walkthrough — procurement blackout this week

Hi Hannah / Grace,

Apologies for the short notice — our procurement team just entered a mandatory blackout for the next 10 business days while they close out an FY change request. That, plus our CFO being on a roadshow Wed–Fri, means our original July 2nd deep technical walkthrough won’t work for decision-makers.

Two asks: can we (1) push the full technical session to the week of July 14th when procurement resumes, and (2) in the interim see if you can do a 30-minute exec summary next week for our VP of Product who will be back in the office on July 7th? If you can do a concise deck and a 30-min slot near July 8–10, that would be ideal.

Thanks — I know this complicates things. We still want to move forward; it’s just timing.

Ethan Cooper
CTO, LumenWare
E: ethan.cooper@lumenware.com
T: +1 415 555 0192

Attachments: none
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Cooper <ethan.cooper@lumenware.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Need to move technical walkthrough — procurement blackout this week

Ethan — thanks for the heads-up and totally understood. We can absolutely accommodate both asks. Proposed plan:

- Short exec summary (30 min) the week of July 7 — we can do July 8 or July 9 in the morning PT. This will be a lean deck focused on value, unit economics, and the PO/timing implications for procurement.
- Full technical walkthrough (60–75 min) during the week of July 14 — we'll lock a slot once procurement confirms available dates.

I’m looping in Karthik (solutions engineering) to confirm the exec deck and technical agenda. Grace — will you take point on the procurement touchpoints / PO timing notes?

I'll attach a one‑pager for the exec summary and a draft walkthrough deck we can pare down for the 30-min session. If the VP prefers recorded pre-read + live Q&A, we can prepare that instead.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Attachments: exec-one-pager.pdf (PDF, 120KB), walkthrough-deck.pdf (PDF, 2.3MB)
From: Ethan Cooper <ethan.cooper@lumenware.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Sandra Li <sandra.li@lumenware.com>, procurement@lumenware.com
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Need to move technical walkthrough — procurement blackout this week

Perfect — exec summary July 8/9 would work. The VP is only available between 10:00–12:00 PT those days. He wants a clear ask at the end (PO size / timing and scope). Procurement asked us to confirm whether a PO is expected before July 25 or if we should aim for August. FYI: CFO travel ends July 11, so July 14 for the full walkthrough is clean.

Can you indicate whether we should plan to have a formal SOW ready for review when procurement unfreezes? That would help them prioritize.

Thanks,
Ethan
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Cooper <ethan.cooper@lumenware.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jul 2025 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Need to move technical walkthrough — procurement blackout this week

Hi Ethan — Karthik here on the SE side. Totals and logistics below so procurement/Vendor Ops have what they need: 

Agenda options (we’ll prep both and flip depending on audience):
- Exec summary (30 min): business case, cost per 1k tokens (hosted vs dedicated), expected throughput for your use case, suggested pilot PO (30–60 days), ask: provisional PO authorization to secure capacity (if procurement allows).
- Technical deep-dive (75 min): architecture, KV caching/latency targets, preferred models and quantization tradeoffs, expected SLOs and rollout plan.

SOW timeline: we can provide a concise SOW draft within 3 business days of procurement signaling intent (includes scope, milestones, SLAs, billing cadence). If procurement can provisionally approve a PO to reserve capacity, that shortens lead time.

Suggested exec slots:
- Tue Jul 8 — 10:30–11:00 PT
- Wed Jul 9 — 11:00–11:30 PT

Calendly (pick a slot): https://cal.com/redwood/hannah-30

If these times clash, tell us two windows and we’ll flex. We'll also prepare a recorded 12‑minute pre-read + 18‑minute live Q&A if that’s preferred.

-Karthik
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: none
From: Ethan Cooper <ethan.cooper@lumenware.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sandra Li <sandra.li@lumenware.com>, procurement@lumenware.com
Date: Tue, 01 Jul 2025 12:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Need to move technical walkthrough — procurement blackout this week

Thanks all — go ahead and book Tue Jul 8 10:30 PT. VP confirmed that window. Procurement also asked you to send the SOW template now so they can glance while in blackout; they won't sign, but want to speed review once unblocked. Can you put a short placeholder SOW in the same HubSpot record? HubSpot company ID is 56821.

I'll expect exec-one-pager and the short recorded pre-read by COB Monday so VP can scan it. Appreciate the flexibility.

Ethan
